verdict.summary: The workflow correctly passes the selected sparq-server feature set through the existing FEATURES environment variable and shell array into cargo-mutants, preserving safe argument handling and the existing advisory/ratchet behavior. The listed features exist, their dependency relationships are compatible (including brtpf implying tpf and the authorization extensions implying solid-authz), and the feature-matrix provides test-enabled coverage for the selected surfaces. The exclusions and the operational risk of a more expensive mutation sweep are explicitly documented without weakening the current gate.
